institution_acts.about_1: Dala isikhungo ngesinqumo somphakathi, bese ugcwalisa imisebenzi yaso ngokuqashwa okukhethekile noma ngokuhetho. I-meter yevoti yesinqumo ikhombisa imingcele yokuphetha. Ukuguqulwa kwesigungu esiphethe kanye nenkantolo kudinga imvume yomvoti lapho indawo yegunya inabavoti.
institution_acts.about_2: Isishayamthetho sivota ngendlela evulekile; ukulawula okuhlukile kosomlomo kuvela kuphela lapho kuvuleka ukulingana kwamavoti. Isibonakude asinakunika isihlalo noma ukweqa ukuhlola ukufayila.
institution_acts.consent_tally: {yes} kwe-{required} izindawo zegunya ezidingekayo ziyavuma ({total} zonke).

institution_acts.hint_committee_judge_co: Kusetshenziswa lapho kungekho zisishayamthetho zabavoti. Ubuncane obuhleliwe benkantolo ngu-{min}.

institution_acts.no_processes: Azikho izinqubo zokuguqula isigungu esiphethe noma inkantolo zalesi sishayamthetho kule khasi.
oversight.gallery: Uyabuka. Ukunakekela kumphakathi — kuhulumeni (Art. II §2). Izikhalo, ocwaningwa, nokuvota ukususa kuphathwa yikhama nohlobo lwehhovisi labo lokuphatha; okutholwe yinkantolo kushicilelwa irekhodini lomphakathi.
oversight.intake_gloss: Kusuka kunoma yimuphi umhlali, noma yimuphi ilungu, noma isinyathelo sekhama ngokwalo. Alikho ifomu lokubhalisa lokwamukela (isikhala sokubhalisa esishaywe isifofane) — isikhalo isenzo esingeyona ifomu esicwaningwayo; uhlu lwezindaba luvulekile emphakathini.
oversight.intake_requires: Ukwamukela kudinga ihhovisi lokuphatha elisebenzayo (F-LEG-013) ne-akhawunti eqinisekisiwe.
oversight.intro: Ihhovisi lokuphatha elizimele liqinisekisa ukuhamba kwenqubo yepalamende nomthetho wokuziphatha. Liyamukela izikhalo zokungaziphathi kahle, lucwaninge, futhi luthumele okutholwe yinkantolo ezinhlelweni zokususa — futhi limemezela isihlalo esingenamuntu lapho izihlalo ziba ze.
oversight.needs_supermajority: Lidinga iningi elikhethekile LAZO ZONKE izikhundla ezisebenzayo — izihlalo ezingenamuntu zisala ekubaleni; usomlomo uyabhala kodwa akavoti (ukulingana kweningi elikhethekile akukwenzeki ngokubala).
oversight.no_office: Alikho ihhovisi lokuphatha — ukwamukela akukwazi ukubhalwa ohlwuhleni kuze kube yilapho ikhama lidala elinye ngesinqumo seningi.
oversight.nominee_hint: Abakhethwa balandela uhlelo lokupointwa nokuvunyelwa — ivoti elilodwa leningi lokuvuma ngamunye; ukuqashwa komphakathi kweminyaka eyi-10 (CLK-09).
oversight.nominee_label: Ama-ID abasebenzisi abakhethwa basebenzisi (elinye ngomugqa, okukhethwayo)
oversight.office_form_citation: Art. II §2 — iningi elijwayelekile lazo zonke izikhundla ezisebenzayo
oversight.removal_gloss: Ukulingana kokususa: isishayamthetho, isigungu esiphethe, namajaji kususwa ngendlela efanayo — iningi elikhethekile lawo wonke amalungu asebenzayo. Usomlomo uyabhala, kodwa hhayi kwiyisigameko sakhe (Art. II §3 · removal.presider, hardened).
oversight.speaker_owncase_suffix: (Usomlomo — icala lakhe lidinga ohlala esihlalweni sokuphetha)
oversight.spk_form_citation: Art. II §3 — ukuphatha icala lakho kuvimbelwe kukodi
oversight.supermajority_note: iningi elikhethekile lawo wonke asebenzayo · Art. VII
referendums.about: Isihlangu se-CLK-19 yisivimbi sokuhlola, hhayi isikhathi: ifayili le-F-LEG-034 elibhekiswe esinqumweni seningi elikhethekile lomphakathi liyanقwa ngaphambi kokuvota ngokucashunwa, nokunanqwa kwayo kufika eketshini lokucwaninga. Isihlangu siyakhululwa lapho ukhetho olulandelayo jikelele luqinisekiswa — izinqumo zenhlolovo zilungiswa ngokuhamba endleleni ejwayelekile.
referendums.blocked_note: Kuvimbelwe kulesi sikhathi · samukelwe yiningi elikhethekile yomphakathi · CLK-19 · siqinile
referendums.convert_note: Art. II §6 — zonke izinqumo zenhlolovo zishintshela emthethweni ojwayelekile ngemuva kokuba ukhetho olulandelayo jikelele luqinisekiswe.
referendums.delegate_gloss_before: Ukudlulisela kufayilwa yilungu elisebenza (F-LEG-023, R-09) — isinqumo ngokwaso sidinga iningi elikhethekile lawo wonke asebenzayo. Noma yimuphi umhlali ufunda lolu hlu; izicelo zifika ephepheni lokuvota elifanayo ngokuhamba
referendums.intro: Isishayamthetho singabeka noma yisiphi isihloko kumphakathi ngeningi elikhethekile. Umkhawulo wokwamukelwa awukhethwa — uhambisana nohlobo lwesinqumo: umbuzo isishayamthetho esingawuphasa ngeningi elilula uxazululwa yiningi yomphakathi; lowo odinga iningi elikhethekile uxazululwa yiningi elikhethekile yomphakathi.
referendums.law_text_hint: Umbhalo obopha owenziwa yinhlolovo — hhayi isifinyezo.
